description: This file provides utility functions for creating mock HTTP requests and responses for testing purposes. It includes functions to generate base requests, full requests with bodies, stalled requests, responses with status and body, and form-encoded bodies.

methods.name: export function makeBaseReq( makeBaseReq
methods.description: Creates a mock IncomingMessage object with specified HTTP method and options, including headers and URL, and supports a destroy method.

methods.name: export function makeReq( makeReq
methods.description: Creates a mock IncomingMessage object with a request body, simulating data and end events asynchronously.

methods.name: export function makeStalledReq( makeStalledReq
methods.description: Creates a base request object that does not emit data or end events, simulating a stalled request.

methods.name: export function makeRes(): ServerResponse & { _status: number; _body: string } { makeRes
methods.description: Creates a mock ServerResponse object with methods to set status and body, along with properties to access them.

methods.name: export function makeFormBody(fields: Record<string, string>): string { makeFormBody
methods.description: Generates a URL-encoded form body string from a key-value record.

ctags.name: _body
ctags.pattern: /^  } as unknown as ServerResponse & { _status: number; _body: string };$/

ctags.name: req
ctags.pattern: /^  const req = new EventEmitter() as IncomingMessage & { destroyed: boolean };$/
